name: Dragonblessed
body:
Despite not being a wyrmtouched, you share a fragment of their power.

Prerequisite(s): Non-wyrmtouched race.

Benefit: You gain the dragonkin subtype.

Special: You must select this feat at 1st level.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
